words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) begins the ayah in dependence, not as a fresh subject. Its feminine singular form carries forward the prior fire description, the complex of {{ar:ٱلْحُطَمَةُ ... نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥuṭamatu ... nāru llāhi al-mūqadah}}) (104:5-6). The reader has to bring that fire across the ayah break before the verb can be heard. The relative clause then defines the fire by what it does: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:allatī taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā al-afʾidati}}) makes the action of rising and inspecting part of the fire's identity, not a later incident.

words.prose: {{ar:تَطَّلِعُ}} ({{tr:taṭṭaliʿu}}) is the word that animates the prior fire. Its hidden feminine subject is recovered from the relative-pronoun frame, so the fire acts without being renamed. The Form VIII shape keeps two motions together: the fire rises upon the hearts and also inspects or becomes aware of them through {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-afʾidati}}). That derived shape makes the fire itself the seeker or inspector, not merely something that rises and not a causative disclosure to another party. That makes the punishment more than blind burning; the fire mounts over the inner target as a knowing, exposing force. The assimilated doubled emphatic stop and guttural release give the action weight and pressure, while the imperfect keeps it ongoing rather than finished. Wider root images of scouting, emergence, and reading sharpen the sense of inspection, but they remain secondary to the locally licensed rising-upon and looking-into frame.

topics.reason: The local frame is intransitive with a {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}})-governed complement, and V4 preserves branches for rising and looking into a matter; this supports a combined ascent-inspection reading without turning the hearts into a direct object.

words.gloss_range: preposition of uponness, dominance, directed contact, and inspected domain
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the hinge inside {{ar:تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā al-afʾidati}}). It does not place the fire merely inside the hearts; it gives the action an upon-relation, with superiority, directed contact, and an inspected domain all present at once. The particle therefore holds the spatial and cognitive sides of the verb together: the fire is over or upon the hearts, and those hearts are what it comes to know. Its sound also binds the phrase locally, as the final guttural of the verb is answered by the opening guttural of the particle, and recitational liaison joins the particle to its definite heart-noun complement. The relation continues in {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) (104:8).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:al-afʾidati}}) is where the clause lands. It is genitive inside {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-afʾidati}}), so the hearts are reached through a preposition rather than seized as a direct object. The definite broken plural makes the target both multiple and gathered as a known class: many inner cores, not one archetypal heart and not a vague mass. The selected noun is fuʾād rather than a generic heart term, so the fire reaches the deepest cognitive-emotional core, the seat that feels and processes truth; the contrast with the broader heart-container is visible in 28:10, and the truth-validation use of fuʾād in 53:11 sharpens the diagnostic force here. The upon-relation stages contact at the surface while the fuʾād sense keeps the target deeply interior. The heat and kindling associations supplied for {{ar:ف أ د}} ({{tr:f-ʾ-d}}) remain a narrowed but real pressure: the word still denotes hearts, yet in the wake of {{ar:نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ}} ({{tr:nāru llāhi al-mūqadah}}) (104:6) the target itself carries an inner burning echo. Its final position and internal hamza make the ayah close on a caught, pierced-sounding inner target before 104:8 expands the upon-relation from hearts to persons.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as definite, broken plural, genitive, and governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), matching the CRITICAL grammar and plurality rows.

topics.reason: The QAC grammar explicitly distinguishes fuʾād from a generic heart term as the innermost cognitive-emotional core; contextual evidence places the noun in perception-related distributions, while missing V4 rows for {{ar:ف أ د}} ({{tr:f-ʾ-d}}) do not block the CRITICAL lexical evidence.

topics.headline: the heart term answers the kindled fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire reaches a heart word whose supplied root-family evidence carries heat and kindling, while the local noun still denotes inner hearts rather than roasted matter.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply Lane and Lisan heat evidence and the nearby context is explicitly the kindled fire in 104:6; because V4 has no rows for {{ar:ف أ د}} ({{tr:f-ʾ-d}}) and the QAC sense is still hearts, the heat image survives as a narrowed lexical echo.

topics.headline: uponness reaches surface and interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) can stage contact upon the heart while the fuʾād sense keeps the target deeply interior.
topics.reason: The reported covering sense is not allowed to replace the local noun's inner-core meaning, but it coheres with the preposition's upon-relation and the noun's interior target.

topics.reason: The full local clause runs from relative pronoun to verb to preposition and closes on {{ar:ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:al-afʾidati}}), supporting the CRITICAL structural rows.

topics.reason: The written and recited form includes an internal hamza and a dāl before the ending, so the sound-shape claim is anchored in the local surface.

topics.headline: inner exposure opens toward enclosure

topics.reason: The CRITICAL bridge is concrete and local: {{ar:ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ}} ({{tr:al-afʾidati}}) closes 104:7, and {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) resumes the upon-relation in 104:8.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins an upward or overlooking motion directly to the definite plural hearts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb can supply an elevated access that uncovers an interior, while the heart-root can supply a center actually struck or afflicted. The motion is therefore not mere arrival at an organ but acquisition of invasive vantage over a vulnerable inside.

activation_trace.role: Overlooking and disclosure make the motion an access to hidden interiority rather than surface contact.
The struck or afflicted heart makes the disclosed interior the point of impact.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified feminine subject comes up to the hearts.
changed_reading.after: It gains an overlooking access to the inward center, exposing and striking what is normally hidden.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rising verb is predicated of an agent whose path terminates at hearts, and the heart noun itself carries a heat-bearing branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: A rising or dawning motion meets the heart as an inner kindling rather than a neutral container. Even before context identifies the feminine antecedent, the focus line permits a thermal resonance in which rising heat encounters latent inward heat.

activation_trace.role: Luminary-like rising supplies upward emergence and the onset of visible intensity.
The heart understood as inward kindling gives the destination its own latent combustion.
Roasting and kindling heat makes the thermal relation materially forceful, not merely emotional.

changed_reading.before: Something rises over an inner human faculty.
changed_reading.after: A heat-bearing agency rises at hearts already lexically figured as inward kindling, allowing heat to meet and expose latent heat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion governs the plural hearts through a preposition that can sustain ranging over a field.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fullness branch of the rising-root changes a punctual touch into exhaustive occupation: the agent ranges across or fills the heart-field to capacity.

activation_trace.role: Fullness to the brim turns ascent into comprehensive range and saturation.
The plural inner-kindling hearts provide the distributed field that is saturated.

changed_reading.before: The agent reaches each heart at one point.
changed_reading.after: The agent ranges through the whole field of hearts and fills their inward capacity without leaving a protected recess.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The heart is the governed destination of a verb whose inventory includes a projectile rising beyond its target.
baseline_models.mechanism: The projectile branch and the struck-heart branch produce a double relation: the heart is hit as a target yet also becomes a threshold the force exceeds. This keeps open a reading of transgressive reach rather than neatly bounded impact.

activation_trace.role: The overshooting projectile supplies a trajectory that rises past the expected stopping point.
The heart struck at its center supplies the target that is reached and exceeded.

changed_reading.before: The heart is the terminal object of impact.
changed_reading.after: The heart is both target and breached threshold: the force reaches the center but is not bounded by an ordinary hit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening totality cue has an encircling-completion branch that strengthens the focus fullness model. Saturation becomes exhaustive in both distribution and enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Fullness supplies the focus-side image of complete inward occupation.
Plural inward-kindling hearts are the field across which the totality operates.
Totality as encompassing completion converts distributive scope into an encircling whole.
A surrounding crown or ring gives the exhaustive whole a spatial edge around what it contains.

structural_cues: The totalizing expression precedes the two repeated aggressor nouns, so exhaustive scope is established before the manner of assault.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, surrounding completion, and focus fullness; I infer exhaustive spatial reach through the hearts, while a merely distributive sense of 'every' remains live.

changed_reading.before: The force can fill a heart or range over several hearts.
changed_reading.after: Its reach is an encompassing totality: the whole inward field is occupied and no recess stands outside the circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired aggressor roots physicalize social injury as squeezing, jabbing, and pushing. Against the focus disclosure and heart-strike, those outward micro-forces reverse direction and return as invasive pressure on the aggressor's own interior.

activation_trace.role: Overlooking disclosure carries the returned force past an outer social persona.
The afflicted heart is the inward site where the recoil lands.
Manual squeezing gives the social offense a compressive material force.
A jab that sets something moving supplies the initiating outward impulse.
Pushing reinforces the offense as directed force rather than only speech.

structural_cues: The paired intensive agent nouns make repeated outward aggression a patterned practice rather than a single utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies squeezing, jabbing, pushing, disclosure, and heart-affliction; I supply the reversal arrow by which outward pressure recoils inward, while simple succession between offense and punishment remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: An external agency independently exposes and strikes hearts.
changed_reading.after: The heartward invasion is a recoil of the offender's own social mechanics: pressure once directed at others returns past the exterior and compresses the inner center.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering dispersed units, making wealth, and recurrent counting form an external inventory practice. The focus disclosure turns that practice inside out: the heart is read as the ledger where dispersed attachments have been assembled into one governing total.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the counter-inspection that makes an inward ledger legible.
The inward heart is the site where the external inventory has become motive and attachment.
Joining dispersed things into a collected unit supplies the ledger's aggregating operation.
Acquiring and multiplying property supplies what the subject treats as stored value.
Enumeration turns the collection into a monitored and repeatedly verified inventory.
Recurring count or time gives the inventory a self-renewing rhythm.

structural_cues: The sequence in one relative clause moves from gathering, to the valued object, to repeated enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aggregation, property-making, counting, recurrence, and inward disclosure; I infer that the outer practice builds an inner valuation ledger, while a reading limited to biography and later physical punishment remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The force discloses an otherwise unspecified hidden interior.
changed_reading.after: It performs a counter-accounting, exposing in the heart the assembled system of attachment that external counting had concealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supposition, imagined sufficiency, wealth, and a thought settled in the heart specify what the focus disclosure finds. The heart is not only heated matter; it is the seat of a lodged permanence-calculus that the rising agency exposes and overturns.

activation_trace.role: Looking into and disclosing a hidden matter makes the inward supposition inspectable.
The heart as inward kindling holds the belief as both cognition and combustible attachment.
Supposition identifies the interior content as a fallible estimate rather than settled fact.
Imagined sufficiency supplies the belief that the stored value can be enough in itself.
Accumulated property is the object credited with sufficiency and duration.
A thought settled in the heart locates the permanence claim precisely inside the focus destination.

structural_cues: The causal syntax attributes enduring power to wealth, and the focus line later names the hearts as the reached interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, sufficiency, wealth, permanence, and a thought resident in the heart; I infer that this resident calculus is what disclosure targets, while undifferentiated bodily burning remains live.

changed_reading.before: The rising heat reaches the heart as physical inner matter.
changed_reading.after: It reaches the exact seat of the false permanence estimate, exposing and burning the settled equation between accumulated value, sufficiency, and survival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Casting away initiates a trajectory, and brittle crushing converts the cast body or construct into fragments. The focus ascent/access and heart-strike continue that trajectory inward: disposal into an external crusher does not stop at the surface but finds the vulnerable center.

activation_trace.role: Ascent and access-point provide the crusher's route from enclosing exterior toward the inner center.
The afflicted heart is the deepest point reached by the casting-and-breaking sequence.
Throwing or casting supplies the abrupt displacement into the destructive process.
Breaking dry matter into fragments supplies the process that undoes apparent solidity.
Perishable debris reverses the earlier claim that accumulated value can confer permanence.

structural_cues: The passive emphatic casting is followed by two verses that identify the destination before the focus line describes its inward reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, fragmentation, perishability, an access route, and heart-affliction; I infer a continuous outside-to-inside trajectory, while external containment and internal injury could remain separate stages.

changed_reading.before: The offender is thrown into a destructive external place.
changed_reading.after: Casting begins a phase change from stored solidity to fragments, and the destructive route continues until it accesses and afflicts the inward center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping keeps both knowing and authoritative impact live around the rhetorical question. Repetition of the crusher then lets the following focus line function as enacted knowledge: its answer is learned through a force that discloses and strikes the heart.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure makes the focus action an unveiling that can answer a question.
A heart actually struck makes the knowledge experiential rather than merely propositional.
The non-dominant mapped root supplies direct knowing as one side of the rhetorical operation.
The dominant mapped root supplies an authoritative blow as the forceful side of the same activation.
Crushing fragmentation gives the enacted answer its specific destructive content.

structural_cues: The rhetorical question repeats the crusher noun, and the next two verses answer first by naming fire and then by stating what it does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two mapped branch families, one for knowing and one for force, plus rhetorical repetition; I infer that the answer can be delivered as experienced impact, while ordinary rhetorical instruction remains the materially live alternative.

summary.what_was_special: The focus line is a compact hinge: its rising-root simultaneously supports ascent, disclosure, saturation, access, projectile excess, and stranger material motions, while its heart-root is already thermally charged. Context does not collapse that plurality; it reorganizes it into coexisting thermal, epistemic, social-reversal, accounting, enclosure, and infrastructural mechanisms.

The force-bearing side of the split knowing-root and the cache, spider, digestive, and botanical branches remain productive but deliberately contained because of branch distance.
The columnar ending can support a static spatial reading alongside the inferred conduit, feed, and duration models.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Fire as investigator of the inward account.** Evidence: `ط ل ع B003` (overlooking/disclosing a matter) and `ف ء د B002` (heart as inner kindling), activated by `ح س ب B002` and `خ ل د B004` in 104:3. Structural cue: the fire named in 104:6 is immediately given an action toward أفئدة. Assigned role: تطلع supplies disclosure; أفئدة supplies the hidden seat. Abductive move: the fire is directed toward where the false reckoning settled. Reading change: the ayah reads less as mere burning and more as inner audit.

2. **A rising luminary inside the concealed person.** Evidence: `ط ل ع B001` (rising of a luminary) with `ن و ر B001/B002` and `و ق د B001` from 104:6. Structural cue: نار is followed by تطلع. Assigned role: طلوع turns the fire's motion into a kind of rising light. Abductive move: the heart becomes the horizon on which the divine fire rises. Reading change: the ayah joins punishment to illumination: the hidden interior is dawned upon.

3. **Scouting the covert gesture.** Evidence: `ط ل ع B004` (scouting vanguard) and `د ر ي B002/B003` (aiming, stealthy pursuit), activated by `ل م ز B001` in 104:1. Structural cue: the surah moves from covert social signaling to a fire that "comes upon" the heart. Assigned role: تطلع is the scout/approach that reaches what concealed speech tried to hide. Abductive move: the only adequate answer to hidden لمز is a disclosure that can track the hidden source. Reading change: the ayah makes judgment a search operation, not only a penalty.

4. **The heart struck by the violence it sent outward.** Evidence: `ف ء د B003` (heart struck/afflicted), activated by `ه م ز B003` and `ل م ز B002` (prodding, pushing, striking) and `ح ط م B001`. Structural cue: outward pressures at 104:1 culminate in an inward target. Assigned role: فؤاد receives the returned force. Abductive move: the social blows dealt through speech are redirected to the center from which they came. Reading change: the ayah turns the punishment inward: the offender's heart becomes the struck object.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 104:8 surprised this ayah by making the fire's access final: it reaches the hearts before enclosure closes over them. 104:9 added vertical and structural resonance; تطلع rises, and then عمد ممددة hold the enclosure in an extended vertical/linear form.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Thermal penetration as disclosure of the interior.** Fixed `تَطَّلِعُ` activates `ط ل ع B003`, overlooking, gaining access to, and disclosing an inward matter; fixed `ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ` realizes `ف ء د B002`, the heart viewed as inner kindling. The prior kindled fire, `و ق د B001`, supplies heat, while the relative clause gives that heat an inward object. The packet supplies movement onto the hearts; I infer that reaching them also reveals the settled orientations within. The line therefore reads as diagnostic penetration: outer fire finds and discloses an already heat-like inner center.

2. **A reversed dawn inside the person.** Fixed `تَطَّلِعُ` activates `ط ل ع B001`, the rising of a luminary, in proximity to `نَارُ`, whose `ن و ر B001` is illumination and `B002` is fire. Unlike an ordinary luminary rising over a horizon, this one rises over plural hearts. The packet supplies fire, rising, and the shifted spatial object; I infer the inversion of the usual outward scene. The ayah can consequently read as an inward dawn whose illumination exposes rather than reassures, with each heart functioning as the horizon of disclosure.

3. **A targeted access-route rather than surface burning.** Fixed `تَطَّلِعُ` activates `ط ل ع B006`, ascent, approach, or access-point, and fixed `ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ` activates `ف ء د B003`, a heart struck or afflicted. The sequence from being cast into the Crusher (`104:4`), through kindling (`104:6`), to the heart, then sealing (`104:8`), supplies a one-way route. I infer that the fire uses the body or enclosure as an approach to a designated endpoint. The construction `عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ` therefore changes the fire from general atmosphere into a directed process that completes itself at the inward target.

4. **The heart as the final material in a consuming chamber.** Fixed `ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ` activates `ف ء د B001`, heat, fire, and implements or places for roasting and baking, alongside its direct heart branch `B002`. Earlier `ٱلْحُطَمَةُ` activates `ح ط م B008`, a grinder or digester, and later `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` activates `و ص د B001`, a chamber sealed shut. The packet gives processing, heat, hearts, and closure; I infer an oven-like coordination without claiming that any single word literally names an oven. The line can thus read materially: the process does not stop at breaking the exterior but subjects the inward center to sustained transformation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `104:8` made the access activated by `ط ل ع B006` one-directional: the fire reaches inward before the enclosure is sealed over its occupants. `104:9` then supplied the extended structure that maintains that asymmetry. The correction is spatially important: `تَطَّلِعُ` is not retained as unrestricted rising, but as successful ingress to the fixed heart-target without a corresponding path of egress.

findings.text: Ateşin yüreklere erişmesi, oraya yerleşmiş yanlış hesabı bulup açığa çıkaran bir iç denetime dönüşür.
Ateş, dış ufukta değil insanın içinde doğan; aydınlatması rahatlatmak yerine gizliyi açığa çıkaran tersine çevrilmiş bir şafak gibi belirir.
Ateş yüzeyde kalmaz; yüreği belirlenmiş son hedef yapan tek yönlü bir giriş yolu izler ve sonraki kapanma geri çıkışı keser.
Ezici'nin tüketen ve kapalı işleyişinde yürek, dış kabuktan sonra sürekli ısıya uğrayan son madde hâline gelir.
Ateşin, örtülü işaret ve niyetleri izleyip kaynağına ulaşan bir öncü gibi davrandığı ileri sürülür.
Başkalarına sözle yöneltilen itme ve darbeler, çıktıkları merkeze dönerek saldırganın yüreğini vurur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Totality and Full Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parts are enclosed in a whole until nothing appears absent and the containing space is filled to capacity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: complete and undiminished whole (`ج م ع:B009/m01`); all-inclusive totality (`ك ل ل:B003/m01`); capacity filled to its limit (`ط ل ع:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gathering reaches a terminal state in which the object is intact, the parts are comprehensively included, and the available space is full. The channel turns counting from an open sequence into bounded completeness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material is fed into heat, transformed by combustion or digestion, and carried from an external fire into bodily and emotional interiors.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The fire scene includes fuel, hearth, cooking vessel, digestive action, inward anger, appetite, vomiting, summer heat, and drought.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ignition, Fuel, Hearth, and Cooking
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fuel is placed at a hearth, rapidly ignited, and used to heat, roast, or bake food before digestion completes the transformation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ignition and flame (`و ق د:B001/m01`); combustible fuel (`و ق د:B002/m01`); hearth or fire-place (`و ق د:B003/m01`); rapid kindling (`و ق د:B005/m01`); visible fire (`ن و ر:B002/m01`); heat and fire (`ف ء د:B001/m01`); roasting or baking (`ف ء د:B001/m02`); hearth and skewer implements (`ف ء د:B001/m03`); large cooking vessel (`ج م ع:B012/m01`); digestive action (`ح ط م:B008/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 نَارُ (`ن و ر`) and ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ (`و ق د`); 104:7 ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ (`ف ء د`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical branches assemble a complete combustion system: material fuel, a bounded hearth, ignition, flame, vessel, food, and digestive breakdown. External fire and internal digestion become parallel mechanisms for reducing and transforming matter.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Heart as an Interior Fire
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Thought lodges in the heart, heat gathers there, and rapid ignition becomes ardor, anger, or social conflict.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: heart as inward heat (`ف ء د:B002/m01`); thought lodged in the mind or heart (`خ ل د:B004/m01`); emotional ardor, anger, or war (`و ق د:B005/m02`); anger's domination (`ع م د:B015/m01`); feud between groups (`ن و ر:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The heart is not merely reached by fire; it already has a lexical capacity for inner burning. A settled thought can kindle into fervor, anger, and conflict, so psychological fixation and social hostility reproduce the dynamics of combustion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gluttony and Emesis
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Appetite consumes beyond restraint until what entered the body rises back out.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: voracious eater (`ح ط م:B008/m01`); rising vomit (`ط ل ع:B011/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Consumption first resembles a fire that breaks food down, then reverses direction as the stomach expels what it could not contain. Rising changes from emergence into emesis.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The invariant links luminaries, beacons, lightning, palms, flowers, shy peeking, sudden arrival, mountain ascent, and conspicuous height.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Luminary Rise and Guiding Light
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A luminary rises, spreads light, and becomes a visible marker by which travelers orient themselves.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rising sun, dawn, moon, or star (`ط ل ع:B001/m01`); illumination (`ن و ر:B001/m01`); beacon or boundary marker (`ن و ر:B005/m01`); cloud-flash or lightning (`ك ل ل:B011/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rise creates visibility, light extends it, and a beacon stabilizes it into orientation. The momentary lightning flash is the compressed counterpart of the enduring guide.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Emergence proceeds from first visible growth to flower and then to a dense stand whose roots draw near one another. The unnamed mixed palm adds generative variety to the same cultivated scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A figure approaches or suddenly appears, looks out from concealment, and withdraws when seen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: appearing arrival or incursion (`ط ل ع:B002/m01`); curious peeking and hiding (`ط ل ع:B008/m01`); visible countenance (`ط ل ع:B009/m01`); shy or startled flight (`ن و ر:B006/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Visibility is unstable: an arrival breaks into view, a face presents itself, and a curious observer alternates between looking and concealment. Shy flight turns appearance into immediate retreat.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ascent, Vantage, and Prominence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or object climbs to an overlooking position and becomes conspicuous through height.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ascent and overlooking access (`ط ل ع:B006/m01`); protruding height (`ط ل ع:B012/m01`); lofty visible structure (`ع م د:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ascent supplies the route, the overlook supplies perspective, and height turns the elevated object into a landmark. The channel joins movement upward with the state of standing above one's surroundings.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knowing, Testing, and Disclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An unknown matter is investigated, tested, learned, and disclosed to another observer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: knowing a matter (`د ر ي:B001/m01`); informing another (`د ر ي:B001/m02`); seeking and testing news (`ح س ب:B010/m01`); inspecting or revealing hidden affairs (`ط ل ع:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Inquiry moves from uncertain report to tested knowledge, then from private discovery to disclosure. Looking into a hidden matter and causing another to know it are consecutive roles in one epistemic process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reconnaissance and Deliberate Raid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Scouts gain sight of an opponent so a force can choose and deliberately approach its target.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reconnaissance party (`ط ل ع:B004/m01`); purposeful targeting or raid (`د ر ي:B002/m01`); deliberate intent (`ع م د:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scout supplies information, intent fixes the objective, and the raid converts knowledge into directed movement. Seeing and striking are ordered stages rather than unrelated acts.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter approaches under cover, aims a pointed implement, releases a force-driven projectile, and either reaches the heart or overshoots the mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealed stalking (`د ر ي:B003/m01`); pointed horn or implement (`د ر ي:B004/m01`); bow-driven impulse (`ه م ز:B003/m02`); arrow overshooting its target (`ط ل ع:B010/m01`); strike to the heart (`ف ء د:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment manages distance, the pointed tool and bow concentrate force, and the heart defines the intended endpoint. Overshooting preserves the same trajectory while reversing its outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The body appears as chest and heart, aged mount, swollen saddle wound, vigorous youth, intact animal, and skin whose color shades into disease.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Heart Ailment, Weakness, and Crushing Pain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Injury or disease reaches the heart, spreads through the chest, and leaves the person weak, fearful, or overwhelmed by pain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: heart ailment (`ف ء د:B003/m02`); weak or absent-hearted state (`ف ء د:B004/m01`); crushing grief, pain, or illness (`ع م د:B008/m01`); chest as bodily enclosure (`ك ل ل:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The chest locates the vulnerable interior, the heart receives disease, and crushing pain changes an organ-level injury into a whole-person state of weakness or fear.

Bunlar tek bir katılımcı düzenine indirgenemeyeceği için dal, görünür veya bilinir kılma ortaklığı korunarak ve katılımcı değişimleri açıkça ayrılarak kabul edilebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen bakma, öğrenme, gösterme ve görüş yoklama kuruluşlarına bağlıdır; genel bilgi edinme ya da açıklama anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye bakarak onun iç yüzünü öğrenmek veya onu başkasına görünür ya da bilinir kılmaktır; birinin görüşünü araştırma ve başı dışarı çıkarıp gösterme de bu kuruluşlara bağlı özel işlemlerdir.

facets.statement: Gözlemleyen kişi bir şeye yukarıdan bakar ya da iç yüzüne erişerek onu bütünüyle öğrenir.
Bilgiyi bilen kişi, bir işi veya saklı sözü başkasına göstererek onun da bilmesini sağlar.
Bir kişinin başını dışarı çıkarıp görünür kılması, fiziksel gösterme alt kullanımını oluşturur.
Birinin ne düşündüğünü anlamak için görüşünü araştırmak, bilgi edinme işleminin özel bir uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar bir şeyi gözleyip iç yüzünü öğrenme ile bilinen şeyi başkasına gösterip bildirme yönlerini birlikte verir. Başı görünür kılma, bir metni inceleme ve birinin görüşünü yoklama bu ortak görünürlük ve bilgi edinme düzeninin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin iç yüzüne erişme, onu başka bir kişiye açma veya birinin düşüncesini araştırma kuruluşlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Başkasına gösterme, başı görünür kılma ve görüş yoklama alt kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, düşmanın durumunu öğrenmek için asker topluluğunun önünden gönderilen kişi veya grupları doğrudan tanımlar. Dalın önden giden gözcü çerçevesi, görevi ve hedefiyle birlikte kaynak tarafından eksiksiz desteklenir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bağımsız kişi ve grup adlarını kapsar; başka dallardaki genel bakma veya bilgi edinme kuruluşları buraya taşınmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, meyvesi yenilen palmiye ağacının açılmamış çiçek salkımını bağımsız bir ad olarak; ağacın bu salkımı vermesini ve ekinin belirmesini ise ayrı kuruluşlar olarak destekler. Dal korunabilir, ancak ürün adı ile bitkinin ortaya çıkma olayı tek bir yalın anlam gibi sunulmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bağımsız salkım adı ile palmiye ağacının salkım vermesi ve ekinin belirmesi ayrı tutulur; olay kullanımları yalın ada yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Meyvesi yenilen palmiye ağacının henüz yarılmamış kılıf içindeki çiçek salkımıdır. Ayrı kuruluşlarda ağacın bu salkımı çıkarması ve ekinin topraktan belirip görünmesi anlatılır.

facets.statement: Palmiye ağacının çiçek salkımı, kılıfı yarılmadan önceki kapalı durumuyla adlandırılır.
Kapalı salkımın tek bir örneği için ayrı tekillik anlatımı bulunur.
Palmiye ağacının çiçek salkımını çıkarması, ürün adından türeyen olay kullanımını oluşturur.
Ekinin topraktan belirip görünmeye başlaması da bitkisel ortaya çıkış olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar palmiye ağacının kapalı çiçek salkımını ve ağacın bu salkımı çıkarmasını birlikte verir. Ekinin ilk kez görünmesi de aynı görünür duruma gelme çizgisinde, fakat ayrı bir bitki kuruluşu olarak yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kapalı palmiye çiçek salkımı adlandırılırken ya da ağacın salkım vermesi ve ekinin belirmesi anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ürün adını, kapalı evreyi ve iki ayrı bitkisel belirme olayını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekili bitkinin ilk sürgününün görünür duruma geldiği bağlamda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü dağa çıkmayı, dağın çıkış ve erişim yolunu, bir işin yaklaşılabilir yönünü ve yüksekten aşağıya bakılan ürkütücü eşiği aynı kuruluş ailesinde verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak fiziksel çıkış, erişim noktası ve soyut yaklaşım yönü ayrı alt anlamlar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım dağ, erişim yolu, işin yaklaşım yönü ve ürkütücü eşik kuruluşlarıyla sınırlıdır; genel yükselme anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dağa yükselip çıkmak veya dağa çıkılan erişim yoludur; buradan bir işin ele alınacağı yön ve yüksekten aşağıya bakıldığında karşılaşılan ürkütücü eşik anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi dağın üst bölümüne doğru yükselerek çıkar.
Dağa çıkılan yol, yükselme noktası veya dağa erişilen yön aynı adla gösterilir.
Bir işin kendisine yaklaşılacak yüzü veya giriş yolu, fiziksel erişimden soyutlanarak anlatılır.
Yüksek bir yerden aşağıya bakarken önünde açılan ağır ve ürkütücü durum özel bir kullanım oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar dağa çıkma ile dağın çıkış ve erişim yerini temel alır. Bu fiziksel düzen, bir işin ele alınacağı yönü anlatmaya genişler; yüksekten aşağıya bakışta karşılaşılan ürkütücü durum da aynı erişim eşiğine bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dağa yükselme, dağa erişim yolu, bir işi ele alma yönü ya da yüksekten görülen ürkütücü karşılaşma anlatılırken kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yeri, avucu, kabı veya su gözünü dolduran çokluğu güçlü biçimde destekler; ancak yeryüzüyle kurulan ifadeyi bazı aktarımlar doluluk, bazıları güneşin gördüğü alan olarak açıklar. Bu nedenle kapsayıcı doluluk çerçevesi, güneşin gördüğü yeryüzü okuması ayrı bir kaynak değişkesi olarak belirtilirse korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Doluluk yalnızca yer, avuç, yay, kap, su gözü ve ölçü ifadelerinde tanımlanır; genel bir dolma anlamı olarak yalınlaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yeri, kabı veya avuç içi gibi sınırlı bir alanı bütünüyle dolduran çokluk ve doluluktur. Yeryüzüyle kurulan özel ifadede, ayrı bir aktarıma göre güneşin gördüğü bütün alan da kastedilir.

facets.statement: Bir şey belirli bir alanı veya kabı sınırına kadar doldurur.
Yeryüzünün dolusu, avucu dolduran yay gövdesi, dolu kap ve dolu su gözü bu ölçülü doluluğun örnekleridir.
Yeryüzüyle kurulan söz, bazı aktarımlarda güneşin üzerine doğup gördüğü bütün alanı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak kümesi, bir alanı veya kabı sınırına kadar kaplayan doluluk anlamını yer, avuç, yay, kap ve su gözü örnekleriyle verir. Yeryüzüne ilişkin sözde ise doluluk açıklaması ile güneşin gördüğü alan açıklaması yan yana bulunur.

concept_gloss.text: bir alanı sınırına kadar doldurma; ayrı aktarımda güneşin gördüğü yeryüzü
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer, avuç, yay, kap veya su gözü ölçüsünde tam doluluk ya da yeryüzüne bağlı güneş kapsamı anlatılırken kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, anlam alanının merkezine yüksek ısıyı koyar; eti ateşte kızartmayı, ekmeği sıcak kül ve köz içinde pişirmeyi, ateş yakmayı, ateşin kendisini, pişmiş ürünü ve bu işlemlerde kullanılan araçlarla yerleri de açıkça bu alana bağlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu işlemleri ve sonuçları birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yüksek ısı ve ateşle ilgili yalın adlandırmaların yanında et kızartma, kül içinde ekmek pişirme ve ateş yakma gibi belirli yapılara bağlı kullanımları ayrı ayrı kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Yüksek ateş ısısını ve bu ısıyla eti kızartma, ekmeği sıcak kül ile köz içinde pişirme ve ateş yakma işlemlerini anlatır. Ateşin kendisini, bu yolla pişmiş ürünü, pişirme aracını ve ateş yakılan ya da pişirme yapılan yeri de adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: Anlam alanının çekirdeği, ateşin yakıcı derecedeki yüksek ısısıdır.
Et, ateşe tutularak kızartılır veya ateşin ısısıyla pişirilir.
Ekmek, sıcak kül ve közün içine yerleştirilerek pişirilir; bunun için kül ile ateş içinde bir yuva da hazırlanabilir.
Topluluğun ateş yakması ve ateşin kendisi aynı ısı merkezinden adlandırılır.
Ateşte pişmiş yiyecek, kızartma veya pişirme aracı ve ateş yakılan ya da pişirme yapılan yer sonuç, araç ve yer uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek ısı çekirdeğini; et kızartma, kül içinde ekmek pişirme, ateş yakma, ateş, pişmiş ürün, araç ve yer anlamlarıyla birlikte sunar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnızca yüreğe isabet etme çekirdeğini verir; bu dal aynı çekirdeğe ek olarak yürek hastalığı durumunu ve yaralanmış ya da hastalanmış sonucu da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hedef olarak yüreği alır ve ayrıca yürek hastalığını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hedef olarak ana atardamarı alır ve o damarın vurulmasını ya da kesilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yaşamsal bir iç yapının hedef alınarak ağır biçimde yaralanmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Eylem türleri yakın olsa da yaralanan yapı aynı değildir: bu dalda yürek, komşu dalda ise ana atardamar hedeflenir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yüreğe yöneltilen darbeyi veya yalnızca yürekte oluşan hastalığı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal göz hastalığı, genel bedensel hastalık, deliliğe benzer durum ve hazımsızlık gibi çok çeşitli rahatsızlıkları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bedenin bir rahatsızlıktan etkilenmesi alanına girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir organı ve ayrıca o organa yönelik darbeyi şart koşar; komşu dalın hastalık alanı çok daha geniştir ve hedefli yaralama çekirdeği yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yüreğin hedef alınmasını ve yürek hastalığını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağrılı yara, deri yarası, yaralı kişi, iğneyle işlenen iz ve üzüntünün yürekte açtığı mecazi yarayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da acı veren bir yaralanma ve bundan etkilenen kişi alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal anatomik hedef olarak yüreği zorunlu kılar; komşu dal ise yaranın türüne ve ağrısına odaklanır, yüreğe ancak mecazi üzüntü bağlamında uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yüreğe isabet etme, başka yaşamsal yapının yaralanması, genel hastalık ve ağrılı yara alanlarıyla en açıklayıcı dört karşılaştırma yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi yüreği yokmuş veya yüreği zayıfmış gibi niteleyerek korkaklık anlamına ulaşır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu nitelemeyi bedensel organ kaybı ya da hastalık diye yorumlamadan, kişilik ve davranış özelliği olarak doğru biçimde sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, kişiyi yüreksiz veya yüreği zayıf sayan yalın nitelemeyi tanımlar; organ yaralanması ve hastalık anlamları buraya aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi yüreği yokmuş ya da yüreği zayıfmış gibi düşünerek cesaretsiz ve korkak diye niteler.

facets.statement: Kişi, korku karşısında cesaret gösteremeyen ve geri duran biri olarak nitelenir.
Korkaklık, kişinin yüreği yokmuş veya yüreği güçsüzmüş gibi kurulan bir anlatımla belirtilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal korkak kişiye yönelik yürek temelli nitelemeyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal korkaklık özelliğini ve bu özelliğin kişiye yüklenmesini daha genel biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişiyi yüreği yokmuş veya zayıfmış gibi niteleyen adlandırmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir şey karşısındaki korku ve ürkmeyi genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da korku karşısında cesaret gösterememe alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yerleşik bir kişilik niteliğini yürek temelli anlatır; komşu dal ise belirli bir şey karşısında duyulan korku ve ürkmeyi de kapsayan daha geniş bir durum alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sürekli bir cesaret eksikliğini, yürek yokluğu veya zayıflığı üzerinden kişiye yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal korkudan yüreğin yerinden çıkması gibi ani sarsılmayı, şaşkınlığı ve düşünce bozukluğunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da korkunun yürek üzerindeki etkisi üzerinden korkaklık alanına yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişiyi korkak diye niteler; komşu dal ise ani korku sarsıntısı ve buna eşlik edebilen şaşkınlık ya da düşünce bozukluğu durumlarını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yalnızca kişideki cesaret eksikliğini yürek temelli bir nitelemeyle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan, topluluk ve devenin bedensel güçsüzlüğünü, inceliğini ve ihtiyaçtan düşkünlüğü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal korkaklığı bir tür güçsüzlük olarak anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın zayıflığı cesaret alanındadır; komşu dal ise bedensel güçsüzlük, incelik ve düşkünlük gibi daha geniş zayıflık türlerini de içerir.
